title: Wendy and the Knock-Knock Hat
synopsis: Wind makes Wendy's blue hat ribbon tap the Story House doorframe, and Ben thinks the quiet door has learned to knock.
continuity_state: Before: Wendy keeps her straw hat with its original blue ribbon and lives west of Bell Hill with Aunt Kay. The picnic banner remains inside her cottage window. The Story House door is now quiet, with a soft click; Ben has invented a wibble-wave. After: Wendy's ribbon briefly taps the doorframe in a puff of wind; the door has not developed a knocking sound. She keeps her blue-ribboned hat and returns with Aunt Kay to Far Meadow by the established route. Ben and Amy know the knock-knock-hat joke; garden has additional leaves, no harvest.
